mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that increases corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to sustained profit growth and reduced risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive over the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that stabilizes yield curves and dampens inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through discounted cash flow compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in PAYEMS and INDPRO (both >0.5% MoM) indicate robust labor market and industrial output growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days via rising corporate margins and earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO increase >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates sustained manufacturing output growth that supports corporate revenue expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through earnings acceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that constrains wage inflation and maintains stable monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through reduced volatility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in HOUST and RSAFS (both >0.5% MoM) indicate strong consumer demand and retail activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through rising consumption and profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through yield curve steepening and risk premium expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month housing starts (HOUST) indicate early economic expansion that drives short-term S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through rising construction activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST increases MoM.
